title: Mishy Mash Reset
style: Jazz phonk club mix with swung percussion, rubbery sub-bass, clipped brass hits, and dusty ride-cymbal chatter; verse rides tight call-and-response between duet commentators and Michelle, pre-chorus strips to bass taps and handclaps, chorus slams with crowd chant stacks and shout doubles. Add Spanish flourishes, tape stop turns, and short sax stabs. Bright, gritty, wide mix with punchy low end., jazz, swing
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Commentator one: look at that stance
Michelle steps in, takes her chance
Commentator two: focus, focus, watch her eyes
Like a bull smash, crisp and wise

She used to serve on tennis lines
Now she paints these tiny lines
Got clipped hard, still she won’t fall
No worries, mate, she wants it all

[Pre-Chorus]
Reset
Set the feet
Soft hands
Clean release
Reset
Count to three
Every shot
A machine

[Chorus]
Mishy mish mash
Reset smash
Mishy mish mash
Reset smash
Crowd go mad
Crowd sing back
Mishy mish mash
Reset smash

[Verse 2]
Michelle sings back: I’m still here
One more step, keep the gears
From the court to the little green floor
I know this rhythm, I know this score

Commentators start to hum
Yeah, here she comes, here she comes
Big black truck tried to steal her pace
But she found fire in a new place

[Pre-Chorus]
Reset
Set the feet
Soft hands
Clean release
Reset
Count to three
Every shot
A machine

[Chorus]
Mishy mish mash
Reset smash
Mishy mish mash
Reset smash
Crowd go mad
Crowd sing back
Mishy mish mash
Reset smash

[Bridge]
[Aussie crowd chant]
Oi, oi, perfect drop
No dramas, mate, don’t stop
Michelle goes suave, muy bien
Then snaps it back again

[Final Chorus]
Mishy mish mash
Reset smash
Mishy mish mash
Reset smash
Commentators sing
Crowd sing back
Mishy mish mash
Reset smash

Mishy mish mash
Reset smash
Yeah, she locks it in
Then hits it back
